```{shinylive-r}
#| standalone: true
#| viewerHeight: 600

source("Global.R")
source("plot_functions.R")
source("Themes.R")

# apps/daily-monitoring/app.R
library(shiny)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)
library(janitor)
library(forcats)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# You already have these somewhere in your project:
# - pretty_var()
# - ak_plot_theme()
# If they live in a script, source it here, e.g.:
# source("R/helpers.R")

ui <- fluidPage(
  tags$h3(textOutput("title"), style = "margin-top:0;"),
  tags$div(class = "ak-card-mark"),

  fluidRow(
    column(
      4,
      dateInput("day", "Date", value = Sys.Date()),
      sliderInput("lookback", "Lookback (days)", min = 7, max = 90, value = 28, step = 1)
    )
  ),

  plotOutput("daily_plot", height = "520px")
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {

  output$title <- renderText({
    paste0("Daily Monitoring - ", format(as.Date(input$day), "%b %d, %Y"))
  })

  daily_mon_raw <- reactive({
    read_xlsx("sample_data/outcome_data.xlsx", sheet = "daily") |>
      clean_names()
  })

  processed <- reactive({
    dm <- daily_mon_raw()

    # most recent date in the data
    daily_mon_most_recent <- as_date(max(dm$date, na.rm = TRUE))

    # lookback window relative to most recent date (matches your original logic)
    daily_mon_past <- dm |>
      filter(date > daily_mon_most_recent - input$lookback,
             date < daily_mon_most_recent)

    wellness_summary <- daily_mon_past |>
      summarise(across(
        where(is.numeric),
        list(
          mean = ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
          sd   = ~ sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
          cv   = ~ {
            m <- mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
            s <- sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
            ifelse(m == 0, NA_real_, s / m)
          }
        ),
        .names = "{.col}__{.fn}"
      )) |>
      pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = c("variable", "stat"), names_sep = "__") |>
      pivot_wider(names_from = stat, values_from = value) |>
      mutate(
        upper = mean + (mean * cv),
        lower = mean - (mean * cv)
      )

    # Use the selected date instead of "today()"
    selected_day <- as_date(input$day)

    day_df <- dm |>
      filter(as_date(date) == selected_day) |>
      select(-any_of("timestamp")) |>
      pivot_longer(-date, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value")

    day_df2 <- left_join(day_df, wellness_summary, by = "variable")

    today_wellness <- day_df2 |>
      filter(variable != "hours_of_sleep") |>
      mutate(var_label = pretty_var(variable)) |>
      mutate(var_label = var_label |> fct_relevel(c("Fatigue", "Stress", "Muscle Soreness", "Knee Soreness")) |> fct_rev()) |>
      mutate(
        Flag = case_when(
          value < lower ~ "Decrease",
          value > upper ~ "Increase",
          TRUE ~ "Normal"
        ),
        Colour = case_when(
          Flag == "Normal" ~ "gray40",
          Flag == "Decrease" ~ "#009E73",
          Flag == "Increase" ~ "#D55E00"
        )
      )

    today_sleep <- day_df2 |>
      filter(variable == "hours_of_sleep") |>
      mutate(var_label = pretty_var(variable)) |>
      mutate(
        Flag = case_when(
          value < lower ~ "Decrease",
          value > upper ~ "Increase",
          TRUE ~ "Normal"
        ),
        Colour = case_when(
          Flag == "Normal" ~ "gray40",
          Flag == "Decrease" ~ "#D55E00",
          Flag == "Increase" ~ "#009E73"
        )
      )

    list(
      day_df2 = day_df2,
      today_wellness = today_wellness,
      today_sleep = today_sleep
    )
  })

  output$daily_plot <- renderPlot({
    p <- processed()

    has_day <- nrow(p$day_df2) > 0 && any(is.finite(p$day_df2$value))

    if (!has_day) {
      # Plot-based message (works better in renderPlot than returning htmltools)
      ggplot() +
        annotate(
          "text",
          x = 0, y = 0,
          label = paste("No Data Yet for", format(as.Date(input$day), "%b %d, %Y")),
          size = 6, fontface = "bold"
        ) +
        theme_void()
    } else {
      # Wellness plot
      p_well <- ggplot(p$today_wellness) +
        geom_bar(aes(x = var_label, y = value, fill = Flag),
                 stat = "identity", width = 0.5, fill = p$today_wellness$Colour) +
        geom_errorbar(aes(x = var_label, ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
                      linewidth = 1, width = 0.5) +
        geom_point(aes(x = var_label, y = mean),
                   size = 2, shape = 23, fill = "#0072B2", stroke = 1.5) +
        geom_text(aes(x = var_label, y = value, label = value),
                  position = position_stack(vjust = .5),
                  fontface = "bold", color = "white", size = 8) +
        scale_y_continuous(
          limits = c(0, 5),
          breaks = 0:5,
          expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05)),
          oob = scales::oob_squish
        ) +
        ak_plot_theme() +
        theme(
          axis.title = element_blank(),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", margin = margin(r = 6)),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
          panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "none"
        ) +
        coord_flip()

      # Sleep plot
      p_sleep <- ggplot(p$today_sleep) +
        geom_bar(aes(x = var_label, y = value, fill = Flag),
                 stat = "identity", width = 0.5, fill = p$today_sleep$Colour) +
        geom_errorbar(aes(x = var_label, ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
                      linewidth = 1, width = 0.5) +
        geom_point(aes(x = var_label, y = mean),
                   size = 2, shape = 23, fill = "#0072B2", stroke = 1.5) +
        geom_text(aes(x = var_label, y = value, label = value),
                  position = position_stack(vjust = .5),
                  fontface = "bold", color = "white", size = 8) +
        scale_y_continuous(
          limits = c(0, 12),
          breaks = 0:12,
          expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05)),
          oob = scales::oob_squish
        ) +
        ak_plot_theme() +
        theme(
          axis.title = element_blank(),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", margin = margin(r = 6)),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
          panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "none"
        ) +
        coord_flip()

      p_sleep / p_well + patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(1, 4))
    }
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

```
